title: Steampunk Hand Over Gothic City
description: A giant black mechanical hand dominates the foreground, its palm and fingers constructed from brass gears, rivets, and steampunk machinery. In the background, a dark gothic city with spires and towers sits beneath a large full moon in a purple and orange twilight sky, with floating semi-transparent signs containing partial text.
prompt: A giant black mechanical hand made of brass gears and rivets reaches across the frame, towering over a sprawling gothic city with sharp spires and illuminated windows. A luminous full moon hangs in a dramatic twilight sky blending deep purple and fiery orange. Semi-transparent floating signs with partial text like NARN, STAR hover near the hand, dark fantasy atmosphere, cinematic lighting, detailed textures.
